SQL:
```sql
SELECT CASE strftime('%w', s.delivery_date) WHEN '1' THEN 'Mon' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tue' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wed' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thu' WHEN '5' THEN 'Fri' WHEN '6' THEN 'Sat' ELSE 'Sun' END AS weekday, CAST(strftime('%w', s.delivery_date) AS INTEGER) AS wd_sort, COUNT(*) AS total_deliveries, SUM(CASE WHEN date(t.arrived_at) < date(s.delivery_date) OR (date(t.arrived_at) = date(s.delivery_date) AND time(t.arrived_at) <= COALESCE(w.window_end,'23:59')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ontime_deliveries, SUM(CASE WHEN date(t.arrived_at) < date(s.delivery_date) OR (date(t.arrived_at) = date(s.delivery_date) AND time(t.arrived_at) <= COALESCE(w.window_end,'23:59')) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS late_deliveries, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN date(t.arrived_at) < date(s.delivery_date) OR (date(t.arrived_at) = date(s.delivery_date) AND time(t.arrived_at) <= COALESCE(w.window_end,'23:59')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) AS ontime_pct, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN date(t.arrived_at) < date(s.delivery_date) OR (date(t.arrived_at) = date(s.delivery_date) AND time(t.arrived_at) <= COALESCE(w.window_end,'23:59')) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)/COUNT(*),1) AS late_pct FROM trip_outcomes t JOIN shipments s ON s.shipment_id=t.shipment_id JOIN sites si ON si.site_id=t.site_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT si2.shipment_id AS shipment_id, ss.seq AS seq, MAX(o.window_end) AS window_end FROM shipment_stops ss JOIN shipment_items si2 ON si2.shipment_id=ss.shipment_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=si2.order_id AND o.site_id=ss.site_id GROUP BY si2.shipment_id, ss.seq) w ON w.shipment_id=t.shipment_id AND w.seq=t.stop_seq WHERE s.delivery_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' AND t.arrived_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY weekday ORDER BY CASE weekday WHEN 'Mon' THEN 1 WHEN 'Tue' THEN 2 WHEN 'Wed' THEN 3 WHEN 'Thu' THEN 4 WHEN 'Fri' THEN 5 WHEN 'Sat' THEN 6 ELSE 7 END
```

SQL:
```sql
SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.returned_cases),0) FROM trip_outcomes t JOIN sites s ON s.site_id=t.site_id JOIN shipments sh ON sh.shipment_id=t.shipment_id WHERE LOWER(s.town)=LOWER('Karimnagar') AND sh.delivery_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31') AS trip_returned_cases, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.returned_cases),0) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=oi.order_id JOIN sites s2 ON s2.site_id=o.site_id WHERE LOWER(s2.town)=LOWER('Karimnagar') AND o.delivery_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31') AS order_returned_cases, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip_outcomes t JOIN sites s ON s.site_id=t.site_id JOIN shipments sh ON sh.shipment_id=t.shipment_id WHERE LOWER(s.town)=LOWER('Karimnagar') AND sh.delivery_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' AND t.returned_cases>0) AS trip_stops_with_return, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN sites s2 ON s2.site_id=o.site_id WHERE LOWER(s2.town)=LOWER('Karimnagar') AND o.delivery_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' AND o.status IN ('returned','partially_delivered')) AS orders_with_return_status
```
Pattern works for any town/date by changing town literal and date range, no hard-coded site/shipment IDs.

September 2026 (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30) weekday-wise performance kosam:

**Nenu find chesindi:**
- On-time = `substr(arrived_at,12,5) <= orders.window_end`, late = `> window_end`.
- Correct join: `trip_outcomes -> shipment_items -> orders` on `order_id + site_id`, DISTINCT order level lo count cheyali. Site+date join saripodu, okka stop lo multiple orders / different windows untayi (ex: S00152).
- Early Sept check: roju ki 5-9 stops, orders tho match avutunnayi (Sept 1: 8 stops, Sept 5: 9 stops). Final weekday % inka raledu.

SQL (run cheyalsindi):
```sql
WITH deliveries AS (
SELECT DISTINCT t.shipment_id, t.stop_seq, o.order_id, o.window_end, t.arrived_at, date(t.arrived_at) AS arr_date
FROM trip_outcomes t
JOIN shipment_items si ON si.shipment_id = t.shipment_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = si.order_id AND o.site_id = t.site_id
WHERE date(t.arrived_at) BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' AND t.arrived_at IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT CASE strftime('%w',arr_date) WHEN '1' THEN 'Monday' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thursday' WHEN '5' THEN 'Friday' WHEN '6' THEN 'Saturday' WHEN '0' THEN 'Sunday' END AS weekday,
COUNT(*) AS total_deliveries,
ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN substr(arrived_at,12,5)<=window_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) AS ontime_pct,
ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN substr(arrived_at,12,5)>window_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) AS late_pct
FROM deliveries GROUP BY weekday ORDER BY MIN(arr_date);
```

result.reply:
Aug 2026 (2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31) — 221 trips, on-time = `status='delivered'` and `arrived_at <= window_end`:

* Sunday: 6 total, 6 on-time, 100.0%
* Monday: 45 total, 39 on-time, 86.7%
* Tuesday: 35 total, 23 on-time, 65.7%
* Wednesday: 32 total, 25 on-time, 78.1%
* Thursday: 34 total, 30 on-time, 88.2%
* Friday: 30 total, 23 on-time, 76.7%
* Saturday: 39 total, 31 on-time, 79.5%

Lowest: Tuesday 65.7%.

SQL:
```sql
SELECT CASE strftime('%w', s.delivery_date) WHEN '0' THEN 'Sunday' WHEN '1' THEN 'Monday' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thursday' WHEN '5' THEN 'Friday' ELSE 'Saturday' END AS weekday, COUNT(*) AS total_trips, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status='delivered' AND substr(t.arrived_at,12,5) <= m.window_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN t.status='delivered' AND substr(t.arrived_at,12,5) <= m.window_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) AS on_time_pct FROM trip_outcomes t JOIN shipments s ON s.shipment_id=t.shipment_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT si.shipment_id, o.site_id, MAX(o.window_end) AS window_end FROM shipment_items si JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=si.order_id GROUP BY si.shipment_id, o.site_id) m ON m.shipment_id=t.shipment_id AND m.site_id=t.site_id WHERE s.delivery_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY strftime('%w', s.delivery_date) ORDER BY strftime('%w', s.delivery_date)
```

SQL:

```sql
SELECT CASE strftime('%w', s.delivery_date) WHEN '0' THEN 'Sunday' WHEN '1' THEN 'Monday' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thursday' WHEN '5' THEN 'Friday' ELSE 'Saturday' END AS weekday, COUNT(*) AS total_trips, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status='delivered' AND substr(t.arrived_at,12,5) <= m.window_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN t.status='delivered' AND substr(t.arrived_at,12,5) <= m.window_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) AS on_time_pct FROM trip_outcomes t JOIN shipments s ON s.shipment_id=t.shipment_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT si.shipment_id, o.site_id, MAX(o.window_end) AS window_end FROM shipment_items si JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=si.order_id GROUP BY si.shipment_id, o.site_id) m ON m.shipment_id=t.shipment_id AND m.site_id=t.site_id WHERE s.delivery_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY strftime('%w', s.delivery_date) ORDER BY strftime('%w', s.delivery_date)
```

SQL:
```sql
SELECT CASE strftime('%w', s.delivery_date) WHEN '0' THEN 'Sunday' WHEN '1' THEN 'Monday' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thursday' WHEN '5' THEN 'Friday' ELSE 'Saturday' END AS weekday, COUNT(*) AS stops, (SELECT MIN(s2.delivery_date) FROM shipments s2 JOIN trip_outcomes t2 ON t2.shipment_id=s2.shipment_id JOIN sites st2 ON st2.site_id=t2.site_id WHERE LOWER(st2.town)=LOWER('Parkal')) AS date_from, (SELECT MAX(s2.delivery_date) FROM shipments s2 JOIN trip_outcomes t2 ON t2.shipment_id=s2.shipment_id JOIN sites st2 ON st2.site_id=t2.site_id WHERE LOWER(st2.town)=LOWER('Parkal')) AS date_to, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipments s3 JOIN trip_outcomes t3 ON t3.shipment_id=s3.shipment_id JOIN sites st3 ON st3.site_id=t3.site_id WHERE LOWER(st3.town)=LOWER('Parkal')) AS total_stops FROM shipments s JOIN trip_outcomes t ON t.shipment_id=s.shipment_id JOIN sites st ON st.site_id=t.site_id WHERE LOWER(st.town)=LOWER('Parkal') GROUP BY weekday ORDER BY stops DESC
```

tool_calls.name: run_query
tool_calls.arguments: {"purpose":"Count delivery stops by weekday for Kazipet town over all history","sql":"SELECT s.town AS town, CASE strftime('%w', sh.delivery_date) WHEN '1' THEN 'Monday' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thursday' WHEN '5' THEN 'Friday' WHEN '6' THEN 'Saturday' WHEN '0' THEN 'Sunday' END AS weekday, COUNT(*) AS stops, MIN(sh.delivery_date) AS from_date, MAX(sh.delivery_date) AS to_date FROM shipment_stops ss JOIN shipments sh ON sh.shipment_id = ss.shipment_id JOIN sites s ON s.site_id = ss.site_id WHERE s.town = 'Kazipet' GROUP BY strftime('%w', sh.delivery_date) ORDER BY CASE strftime('%w', sh.delivery_date) WHEN '1' THEN 1 WHEN '2' THEN 2 WHEN '3' THEN 3 WHEN '4' THEN 4 WHEN '5' THEN 5 WHEN '6' THEN 6 WHEN '0' THEN 7 END"}

Sep 2026 deliveries (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30): 15 damaged cases total in 226 stops.

Breakdown with damage:
- Hanamkonda CN-0032: 6 damaged / 824 delivered, 9 stops
- Jagtial CN-0030: 4 damaged / 3863 delivered, 6 stops
- Siddipet CN-0035: 3 damaged / 856 delivered, 5 stops
- Jangaon CN-0006: 2 damaged / 1591 delivered, 13 stops
- All other 39 sites: 0 damaged

SQL:
```sql
SELECT si.town AS town, t.site_id AS site_id, COUNT(*) AS stops, SUM(t.damaged_cases) AS damaged_cases, SUM(t.delivered_cases) AS delivered_cases FROM trip_outcomes t JOIN shipments sh ON sh.shipment_id = t.shipment_id LEFT JOIN sites si ON si.site_id = t.site_id WHERE sh.delivery_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY si.town, t.site_id ORDER BY damaged_cases DESC, town, site_id
```
Source: trip_outcomes.damaged_cases joined to shipments.delivery_date.

Allowed lesson kinds and their params (use ids exactly as they appear in the evidence):
- site_access: {"site_id", "max_length_ft"}  (longest vehicle that can enter this one site)
- receiving_hours: {"site_id", "until_hour"}  (site does not receive after this hour)
- night_only: {"site_id", "from_hour", "to_hour"}  (site receives only at night)
- time_window: {"site_id", "min_length_ft", "from_hour", "to_hour"}  (vehicles of this length or longer can't unload in this window)
- weekly_off: {"site_id" or "town", "weekday"}  (weekday 0=Mon .. 6=Sun; closed that day)
- alias: {"phrase", "target_kind": "site"|"vehicle"|"vendor", "target_id"}  (target_id = site_id, vehicle_id, or vendor name)
- real_capacity: {"vehicle_id", "max_kg"}  (vehicle safely carries less than its paper payload)
- vendor_reliability: {"vendor", "condition": "month_end"}  (vendor often fails to place trucks in that period)
- closure: {"town", "what", "valid_from", "valid_to"}  (temporary road problem; dates YYYY-MM-DD)
- moved_site: {"site_id", "since"}  (site moved; master address is out of date)
- vehicle_requirement: {"town" or "site_id", "vehicle_class"}  (only if trips with other vehicles actually failed)
- other: {"description"}

children.request: సెప్టెంబర్ 2026 (2026-09-01 నుండి 2026-09-30) డెలివరీలలో పాడైన (damaged) కేసుల సంఖ్య లెక్కించండి. existing tools (trip_history, performance, order_history) లో damaged field లేదు. records tables లో damaged_cases / damage / shortage / breakage వంటి columns కోసం describe_tables చూసి ONE read-only SQL SELECT వాడండి. మొత్తం damaged కేసులు + వీలైతే site/town వారీ breakdown ఇవ్వండి. analyst ఇప్పటికే 2026-09-19 న 3 cases damage అనే ఒక note కనుగొన్నాడు.
children.reply:
Sep 2026 deliveries (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30): 15 damaged cases total in 226 stops.

Breakdown with damage:
- Hanamkonda CN-0032: 6 damaged / 824 delivered, 9 stops
- Jagtial CN-0030: 4 damaged / 3863 delivered, 6 stops
- Siddipet CN-0035: 3 damaged / 856 delivered, 5 stops
- Jangaon CN-0006: 2 damaged / 1591 delivered, 13 stops
- All other 39 sites: 0 damaged

SQL:
```sql
SELECT si.town AS town, t.site_id AS site_id, COUNT(*) AS stops, SUM(t.damaged_cases) AS damaged_cases, SUM(t.delivered_cases) AS delivered_cases FROM trip_outcomes t JOIN shipments sh ON sh.shipment_id = t.shipment_id LEFT JOIN sites si ON si.site_id = t.site_id WHERE sh.delivery_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY si.town, t.site_id ORDER BY damaged_cases DESC, town, site_id
```
Source: trip_outcomes.damaged_cases joined to shipments.delivery_date.

patch.text: For weekday or other custom breakdowns with no dedicated tool: call describe_tables once, then use ONE SELECT with GROUP BY in SQL; do not loop per day or try other tools first.
